property_summary: Invariant: Only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership(newOwner) (call returns/does not revert) for any newOwner != address(0); the mutant removes the onlyOwner restriction so some non-owner caller can successfully change owner, violating this rule.
change_summary: Made transferOwnership callable without the onlyOwner restriction by removing the modifier invocation, allowing anyone to change owner.
